plan.question: Does the complete-shared-row magnitude intervention yield a repeatable validation AUC benefit over the unchanged-gradient control, and is any benefit specific to query/history conflict rather than generic row scaling or Adam conditioning? At seed 42, r0017-half_total_magnitude minus r0017-half_none_bridge is +0.0001774051692153833 AUC but +0.000006378891288821853 Logloss (worse); r0017-half_total_direction minus none is -0.00031232271049141946 AUC, and projection minus magnitude is -0.00008863106995493641 AUC. These observations weaken directional-benefit attribution without establishing a magnitude mechanism. First resolve the reproducibility limitation: r0017-half_project_bridge differs from r0016-half_project by +0.00006079325137475777 AUC and -0.00004412084125918203 Logloss despite equal exported configs and different source hashes. Retrieve authorized implementation and independent common-state gradient/update evidence before proposing more interventions; then prioritize a fixed four-cell paired-seed comparison if an execution interface is granted. Preserve the negative direction outcome, loss tradeoff and source-version mismatch.
missing_information: Authorized old/new projection source bodies and exact training/config/checkpoint provenance, including initialization, data order, guard definitions, decomposition and accumulation order; equal config alone does not explain bridge drift. Current workspace exports no model files or ancestor sources.

Independent common-state supervised-gradient audit of the complete shared-row sum including other paths: unchanged forward/scalar BCE; actual N/P/D/M backward; norm/direction identities; and zero padding/outside-eligible corrections. Candidate-authored snapshots and through-checkpoint summaries are supporting diagnostics, not independent verification.

Authorized common-parameter/common-moment Adam audit of actual update norms/directions and optimizer buffers. Preserving raw-gradient direction does not establish preservation of optimizer-update direction; no optimizer state is currently exported.

A permitted paired-seed execution interface for the fixed current none/project/total_direction/total_magnitude suite at seeds 43 and 44, after implementation audit. Current evidence uses seed 42 only; deterministic replays are not independent repetitions. Report every paired AUC/Logloss contrast and do not emulate new seeds through model code.

If repeatability and integrity survive, a separately admitted conflict-independent scaling replacement matched for capacity, forward, training recipe, scaling distribution and measured cost. Its design must distinguish conflict-dependent allocation from generic magnitude/conditioning effects; no such control has been executed.

Primary-source coverage for nearest gradient surgery, gradient normalization and Adam-conditioning methods. The authorized paper search for Adam gradient normalization magnitude preconditioner returned no matches; this is a retrieval gap, not evidence of novelty. No new industry card is requested because the concrete limitation concerns backward attribution and reproducibility rather than an observed forward-architecture deficit.

Authorized validation predictions and user identities for paired user-cluster uncertainty, plus exact predeclared slice bins and both-class counts, if available. Retain empty-history/hour/composition reversals and distinguish exploratory slices from confirmatory comparisons; aggregate exposure counts cannot provide cluster intervals.

Refreshed host resource ledger, audit/repetition/assessment tariffs and explicit final assessment interface.
